live_authorization_phrase_required: ENABLE LIVE TRADING WITH MAX BANKROLL $50
_immutable: Deployment configuration. Running code never writes this file; mutable run state lives in state/evaluation.json.
_broad_scan_note: WEATHER-ONLY RUN. The broad all-markets scan is OFF by default. This system only auto-trades weather markets, so paging up to 20,000 non-weather markets every 10 minutes would spend thousands of API requests a day on markets it can never act on. Explicit weather discovery (category + tag + search) is unaffected and still runs to exhaustion. Set this to true ONLY alongside a deliberately designed non-weather strategy; on its own it just populates state/shortlist.json for manual review and changes no trading behaviour.
